essence: One may alternatively worship by offering bilva leaves individually.
Even a householder may worship a single śālagrāma stone.
One should not worship Durgā with dūrvā grass nor the sun-god with bilva leaves.
The wise should always avoid dhattūra and arka flowers in the worship of Viṣṇu.
One should not worship the son of Devakī with bilva leaves or bilva flowers.
